title: Pipe popover anchor math is duplicated in app and render — hit-test and draw can silently diverge
detail: The pipe popover anchor (midpoint formula) exists in app/main.odin and again inline in render. If the draw side moves its anchor, the app's hit-tests silently drift — exactly what the single-source rule prevents.
recommended_fix: Export the anchor (and ideally one current_popover_rect proc) from render/popover.odin and call it from both app hit-tests and the draw, so geometry has one owner.

title: Drag-branch release click-select skips the press_swallowed gate — ESC mid-click re-selects
detail: Press on a junction starts drag.active; ESC sets press_swallowed but leaves drag.active set, so the release takes the drag branch, which never consults press_swallowed — click_select re-selects, contradicting the comment and the PR's interaction map.
recommended_fix: Add !app.press_swallowed to the drag-branch click-select condition (or clear drag.active in the non-placing ESC branch) so the latch's contract holds on every release path.
